body:
Sub-tasks (approved plan):

1. Fixture helper `promoDialog` in the Discord test builder (light)
2. Unit tests for blocking dialog detection and rendering (standard)
3. Formatter fix: detect unnamed root-level modal, render `BLOCKING POPUP` block first, add `hasBlockingDialog` / `blockingDialog` extras (complex)
4. Live test via a temporary custom-formatter shadow, read-only tree fetches (standard)
5. Workflow guard: all five workflows return a blocked result with a reason while a popup is open (light)
6. Manifests 1.3.0 -> 1.4.0 and top-level 5 -> 6, notes, CHANGELOG, re-sign (standard)
7. Sync the shadow copy to the final files and leave it in place until the next release is installed (light)
8. Final verification, no push until approval (light)
